title: 第7章 《五禽新书》
content_zh:
泡水有用吗？
李皓完全不知道，他佩戴星空剑很多年了，平日里玉剑也不是没见过水，洗澡什么的，他也不会取下来，也没见以前有什么作用。
小时候还含在嘴里很多次，也没有任何效果。
可这一次，好像有用，起码对黑豹有用。
厨房中。
一个大大的汤碗被李皓取出，星空剑就被放在其中。
李皓加了一壶开水进去，他在思考，是不是开水才能有用？
洗澡，自然不会用开水洗澡，是否是以前的温度达不到条件，玉剑上的一些神秘物质，达不到融化开启的条件？
之前黑豹舔了几口，好像也没什么效果。
直到李皓用开水消毒，泡出来的水被黑豹喝了，黑豹才有了反应，皮毛迅速变的光滑起来。
“如果开水不行，那就再用火煮煮看。”
“要不然，我也没办法了，难道只有狗才能吸收其中的神秘物质？”
这一刻的李皓，天人交战。
彷徨，激动，兴奋，又担心竹篮打水一场空。
他渴望跨入神秘领域！
也许那样，自己就有办法去对付红影了。
此刻，他需要自己获得这样的力量，外面有人监视自己，红影随时会到来，巡夜人可能在寻找可以看到红影的人，巡检司内部还有内鬼……
心中思考着这些，李皓眼神愈加执着。
这次不行，那自己也不会放弃。
开水已经泡了一会星空剑，汤碗中的水，也没有什么变化。

脚下，黑豹有些昏沉，趴伏在地，抬着狗头看向汤碗，还是有些渴望，但是好像喝不下了，少了一些之前的迫切感。
“呼！”
李皓深吸一口气，没有急着去喝，端着碗，走出厨房。
锁好了防盗门，拉好了窗帘。
确保不会被外人看见，若是有人闯入，也能及时发现，李皓这才端着碗回到了沙发上坐下。
碗中，玉剑还在，此刻好像愈加晶莹剔透起来。
当然，也许只是自己的错觉。
“李家的剑……能在俚曲中流传多年，多少有些神秘之处吧？”
李皓端起碗，咬了咬牙，将手枪放到了身边，随时可以拿到，这才小心翼翼地喝了一小口，很小的一口，水还是有点烫，不过李皓也不在意这些。
一口开水下肚，一开始并无任何反应，只感觉烫。
可慢慢地，李皓好像察觉到了一丝丝不同之处。
一股暖流，在肚中渐渐扩散开。
不过很快这股暖流就消失不见了。
李皓眼神疯狂闪烁起来，真的有用？
还是说，只是错觉罢了？
他怕是自己的错觉，心理感应，并非真的有暖流存在。
“喝不死人就行！”
李皓这次胆子大了一点，又是一口水入腹，这一次喝的更多一点，而这一次，感受也更明显一些！
真的有暖流在肚中流淌！
非但如此，这一刻，李皓低头，迅速看向自己的肚子，肚皮附近，好像有股淡淡的星光闪烁一般。

“神秘力量？”
李皓心中震撼，这是神秘力量吗？
自己喝下了这水，居然肉眼可见地看到了一股星光般的光芒闪烁。
然而，下一刻李皓脸色有些变幻。
那股星光般的光芒，忽然开始熄灭，开始流逝，渐渐地消失，泯灭在了李皓身体四周。
有些昏沉的黑豹，忽然睁眼，朝李皓这边爬来，舌头伸出，朝四周空气中虚空舔了舔，可惜好像什么都没舔到。
“嗯？”
李皓微微凝眉，迅速判断了起来。
“星光是神秘力量吗？”
“先是出现在肚中，然后溢散了出来，然后消失了……这……是我留存不住这股力量吗？”
他对神秘力量，一无所知。
不过他练过擒拿格斗，知道一个道理，任何东西，都是需要一些套路、规则去整理收纳的。
乱锻炼，有时候不但不能强身健体，反而会把自己给练废了，这点他的老师袁硕曾经说过。
而他，现在是个彻头彻尾的无知者。
这股力量，也许就是他渴求的神秘力量，然而自己却是没有办法保存下来，只能任由这些力量流淌出去。
“神秘力量，难道说，需要什么秘籍之类的才行？”
李皓这时候看了一眼黑豹，黑豹自然也不会什么修炼方式，不过黑豹也不是修炼，只是让星光力量流淌自身，这股能量，哪怕只是在体内蕴留一阵，好像都有些强身健体的作用。
这时候的李皓，看向碗中剩下的水。
迅速得出了几条结论。
第一，玉剑上真的蕴含一股星光一般的能量，但是需要开水中和，才能将那股能量渗透到水中。

第二，这股能量有强身健体的作用，但是留存不住。
第三，神秘力量的获得，可能需要秘籍或者有其他体系，并非吸收了，吃了，就能具备这股力量。
第四，自己可能是个废材？
李皓想到第四点，也不是乱想，他在思考，神秘力量的修炼，是否有什么要求，自己是否具备这个要求？
要是其他人喝了这水，是否能够留存下来，而自己不能？
这并非不可能的事！
如果人人都能具备神秘力量，那偌大的银城，不可能几乎无所闻，也就隐约知晓有巡夜人的存在，而且对方数量恐怕不会太多。
将这几点记下，李皓感受了一下自己的身体。
感觉变化不大。
并没有想象中的瞬间力大无穷，也没有和黑豹一样，一下子就头发黑亮起来，皮肤光泽起来。
“感觉和泡了温泉差不多，肚子里热热的，其他的感受……不太多！”
李皓喃喃一声，下一刻，忽然有些无奈。
我的变化，怎么连一条狗都不如？
黑豹喝了这水，好歹肉眼可见地毛发变亮了，自己倒好，居然没太大的感觉。
“难不成，我还不如黑豹？”
李皓苦笑一声。
他也在猜测，是否是第一次泡的水，效果更好一些，可这也不好说，也许是自己真的不如黑豹呢？
那才怄死人！
“这样可不行，那些星光能量好像都浪费掉了，从我体内溢散出来之后，很快就没了。”
李皓皱紧了眉头，看着碗中还剩下的大半碗水，此刻不敢再喝了。

怕浪费！
这股力量，在水中还能留存，喝下去也能进入肚子中，可一旦从肚子中溢散出来，就直接消失了。
“星空剑是可以一直泡水，还是说是次数限制的？”
太多的不确定，让李皓不敢轻易再浪费这碗水了。
“我现在缺乏对星光能量的留存能力，如果能将这股能量全部吸收进入体内，也许会有一些变化……”
“也不对！”
这时候，李皓忽然想到了什么，喃喃道：“主要还是我是无源之水，这股能量进入体内吸收的不多，很快消失，可能是因为我体内不存在神秘能量的根源……”
只是猜测，李皓对这方面的信息，实在是知晓的太少。
“不能眼看着浪费，这碗水也不知道能保持多久的效果……”
他站了起来，想到了什么。
也许，可以尝试一下老师传给自己的《五禽新书》。
一本可以正确合理养生的小法门，是自己老师根据一些古文明记载改编的，老师七十多岁了，还能健步如飞，甚至还能暴揍李皓，这本《五禽新书》还是有些作用的。
《五禽新书》不涉及什么具体套路招式，就是最大限度合理锻炼全身肌肉骨骼，也和神秘体系毫无关联。
此刻的李皓，想到这个，也是因为觉得自己锻炼一番，也许可以吸收更多的星光。
至于有没有作用效果，那只能尽人事听天命了。
五禽新书，讲述的是五种禽兽日常中捕猎、逃跑的一种基本反应，虎之威猛，鹿之安舒，熊之沉稳，猿之灵巧，鸟之轻捷。
李皓的老师袁硕，格外擅长精通猿、鸟两种禽兽之法。
简单来说，袁硕希望自己可以和猿猴一样灵巧地逃跑，像飞鸟一样，轻捷灵便，可以跨越各种障碍，有利于遇到危险第一时间逃跑。
至于李皓，在银城古院期间，跟着老师学习，只是学习了猿猴之法，其他四种，都是简单接触，并未深入研究，这东西并非一朝一夕就可以精通的，需要持之以恒的学习锻炼。
“试试看！”

李皓也非优柔寡断之辈，何况试试又不损失什么。
他稍微热了热身，感觉比之前好像更容易适应，很快，端起汤碗，喝了一口玉剑泡的水。
下一刻，李皓如同猿猴一般，动作敏捷，脚后跟抬起，双脚一瞪，竟凌空跃起，双手灵便，瞬间如同猿蹄钩起，一把抓住客厅中间悬挂的吊环，在吊环上荡漾起来。
这吊环，也是李皓后来装的，当初就是为了学习《五禽新书》特意准备的。
猿术，讲的就是一个灵便。
这也是李皓的老师所擅长的，所以李皓第一个学的就是这个，利用现有的环境，尽可能地创造更好更快更省力的逃跑方式。
此刻，李皓进入了状态，只觉得身体比之前好像更灵便许多。
抓住吊环，荡漾一会，双脚踢到墙壁，借力腾空，又是张牙舞爪，如同猿猴一般，再度凌空跃起，一把抓住前方的沙发靠背。
双手借力，李皓继续在不大的客厅中到处乱窜。
小小的客厅，东西很多，其实空间不大。
可此刻，李皓在这不大的空间中，身影不断闪烁，极其灵便。
他力量不算太强，体格也并非那种极其壮硕的样子，比起好友张远，李皓真的像读书苗子，而张远更像一头熊。
李皓这样的体型，却也恰好能和猿术匹配上。
体格太大，在这小小的空间中，反而会施展不开。
“呼！”
急促的呼吸声，在小小的客厅中响起。
这看似简单的猿戏，其实极其消耗体力，还要配合《五禽新书》中标注的呼吸之法，才能合理运用自己的体力。
这呼吸之法，不是什么高深的武功秘籍，只是简单地教你如何调整呼吸，什么时候该吸气，什么时候该呼气，如何屏息，怎样才不会岔气……
当然，说起来简单，做起来难，改编出《五禽新书》的袁硕，五禽戏其实好改编，但是为了改编出匹配的呼吸之法，袁硕废了很大精力。
所以《五禽新书》在银城古院不稀奇，很多人其实都会，袁硕藏了一手的就是其中感觉不太重要的呼吸之法。

而这呼吸法，袁硕也就传给了自己几个学生罢了。
此刻的李皓，呼吸急促起来，开始不断调整。
一整套猿戏，其实时间不长，从头到尾也就三分钟左右，三分钟，足够让一个成年人在这种高强度的快速移动下精疲力尽。
李皓练了三年，到现在也不过能勉强做完两次，6分钟左右就会力竭，有些爬不起来。
而他的老师，七十多的人了，体力比李皓都要充沛，据说最高纪录是做了五次，持续了15分钟。
这种高强度，高速度，灵活度极高的动作持续15分钟，李皓一直是不太相信的。
遇到危险，若是能如猿猴般逃跑15分钟，持续不泄力，那安全度会大大增高。
当然，此刻的李皓没心思多想了。
在黑豹有些目瞪口呆的眼神下，李皓迅速移动。
家中的桌椅，沙发，茶几，墙壁……都成了李皓的借力点，整个房间，只能看到李皓不断挥洒汗水的身影。
“两次了！”
第二次回到原点，李皓呼吸有些不稳了，却是感觉自己还有余力，他眼中顿时露出喜悦的光芒。
神秘的星光能量，有什么其他好处他不知道，可此刻李皓感受到了一点，这玩意能增强自己的体力，也让自己的身躯好像更加轻盈了一些。
以前做猿戏，李皓总觉得有些不太舒服，身体太沉重，每一次跳跃，每一次借力，都很费力，也很累。
可今日，好像轻松了一些。
“也许我还可以再做一次！”
李皓这时候才有时间看自己的肚皮，之前肉眼可见的星光好像消散了许多，可李皓皮肤表面，好像浮现出一层淡淡的星光。
当然，这种星光很快也会消散，但是李皓能感受到，这些星光被自己吸收了许多。
这一刻，李皓心中微动。
神秘力量，到底是什么？

巡夜人中的高手，为何神秘？
他不太清楚，这些人是身手好，还是和红影一样，具备一些特殊的能力，比如说别人看不到，比如说会放火？
若是单纯的身手好，那李皓觉得，自己都不需要了解巡夜人，也许自己这么喝水下去，持续锻炼下去，自己身手也会越来越好。
“继续！”
李皓顾不得去想了，此刻的他，心情极其亢奋。
虽然很累，已经练了两次，可他觉得自己还能继续坚持下去，关键在于，那些泡出来的水，他还没喝完呢。
再次喝下一大口泡剑水，李皓再次腾跃起来。
“楼上又来了！”
与此同时，二楼的老邻居骂了一句，以前李皓也喜欢在家锻炼，不过持续时间不长，一般也就几分钟完事。
今天倒好，这是磕了药了？
都半个小时了，楼上还有动静。
这老楼的隔音可没那么好，若不是那小子现在是巡检，二楼的大妈都准备上门开骂了。
“砰！”
来回练了好几轮，休息一阵，喝口水，继续练。
这一次，李皓没有和以往一样，练个两次就停。
一直到碗中的水喝完，李皓这才如同沙袋一般，重重砸倒在地，一瞬间觉得连起身的力量都没有了。
“呼！”
大口喘气，很快，李皓闭嘴，开始按照《五禽新书》的呼吸法，来调整呼吸。
刚锻炼完，大口呼气不是很好。
《五禽新书》上有说明，这时候还得慢慢调整呼吸，不然前面的锻炼效果，那得浪费一大半。

“呼……”
李皓调整了一阵，眼中满是喜色。
当然，不是连贯的九次，中间有过停歇，自己老师说的五次，那是持续不断的情况下，李皓并未打破自己老师吹牛说的记录。
可今日，李皓之前也做过一次三连贯，坚持了9分钟！
而且之后，他还有余力继续锻炼，这就很可怕了。
“这水……神水啊！”
李皓想到这，倒吸一口冷气，难道巡夜人或者那红影，都是通过这种手段强大自己的吗？
自己只是第一次喝，第一次接触，就感觉效果好的超乎想象，体力感觉比以前充沛的多。
那些人，若是持之以恒地锻炼，哪怕不能放火，不能具备那些超能力，也极其可怕了吧？
“我……可能小看了巡夜人，这些人若是每天都这样提升，不动用超能力，旋涡三代真的可以打中他们吗？”
几乎不可能！
旋涡三代有效射程不过50米罢了，对方在50米之外，李皓没有准头可言。
在50米之内，李皓觉得，可能自己都来不及开枪，对方就近身扭断了自己的脖子！
再要是有点超能力，比如隔空放火什么的，那压根不可能伤害到他们。
“枪械……可能无用！”
李皓心中忌惮更多了，枪械可能对红影也没任何作用。
下一刻，他看向碗底的玉剑，一把拿到手中，眼中满是渴望和期待：“每天泡水的次数有限制吗？每次都可以泡出这样的神秘水吗？”
若是无限制的，随意泡，那代表李皓每天都可以喝，随便喝！
怕就怕，这东西是有限制的，神秘的星光力量也不是无限的。
李皓本想再研究研究，看了一眼墙上的挂钟，微微皱眉，今日算了，都8点钟了。

他得出去一趟！
去张远家看看。
现在不看，接下来未必有机会和时间去看了，他现在被人盯上了，趁着今天对方刚注意到他，他得及时去查探一下，张远家的那把石刀还在不在。
“星空剑有这样的能力，那……张家的刀呢？”
这一刻，李皓觉得，红影的目标，也许就是这些兵器？
“李家的剑，张家的刀……若是对方的目标是这些，那张家的刀未必还在了，不过也难说啊！”
李皓心中想着，的确不好说。
张家的刀，红影真的发现了吗？
那是一块石头罢了，丢在地上，完全没有任何异常，张家那边也不是太在意，张远父母死后，张远压根从不在意那块石头，指不定就扔哪去了。
张远本人都不在乎，那红影或者其背后的势力，能找到吗？
“可要是没找到……也许张家那边还有人盯梢！”
李皓心中微微震动，这样的话，找到了反而安全一些，找不到，他去张家，可能还有点危险。
去还是不去？
很快，李皓有了决定，得去，当然，安全措施要做好。
他已经有了打算，哪怕去，也得保证自己安全才行。
若是能找到张家的刀，那更好了。
玉剑可能有次数限制，也许几次之后就没效果了，可张家的刀，要是也有这效果，那代表李皓可以多一些机会。
李皓迅速起身，很快进入浴室冲洗了一下。
没一会，李皓走出浴室。
穿好衣服，佩戴上玉剑，拿起手枪。

刚要出门，想了想看向趴在地上的黑豹道：“走，跟我一起，你鼻子灵，帮我盯梢一下！”
黑豹今天也喝了水，还是有些好处的。
这家伙还是条狗，若是有人跟着自己，自己没发现，黑豹也许能发现。
“汪！”
黑豹摇了摇尾巴，屁颠屁颠地爬了起来，好像有些兴奋。
李皓笑了笑，摸了摸它的狗头，轻声道：“不要乱叫，咬人的狗不叫！你好像变聪明了，能听懂我的话，若是发现有人跟着我，别瞎叫唤，咬我裤腿，我就明白了！会吗？”
黑豹居然点头了！
狗头点了几下，一口咬上李皓的裤腿，李皓顿时笑了。
这比巡检司那几条受过专业训练的神犬还要通人性，厉害，黑豹也许可以给自己带来一些帮助。
拍了拍黑豹脑袋，李皓想了一会待会如何应对，解除一些可能存在的危机。
确定了方案，李皓这才带着黑豹一起走出了家门。
去张远家！
PS：居然百盟了，没想到啊，感谢大家大力支持，不枉我给我自己打赏了一个盟主，嘎嘎嘎，希望大家没看到。

Does soaking in water help?
Li Hao had no idea that he had been wearing the Starry Sky Sword for many years. It was not like he had never seen the jade sword in water. He would not take it off for bathing or anything else, and he had never seen any effect before.
I kept it in my mouth many times when I was a child, but it had no effect.
But this time, it seemed to work, at least for Black Panther.
In the kitchen.
A large soup bowl was taken out by Li Hao, and the Starry Sky Sword was placed in it.
Li Hao added a pot of boiling water to it. He was thinking whether boiling water would be useful?
Naturally, you would not use boiling water to take a bath. Could it be that the previous temperature did not meet the conditions, and some mysterious substances on the jade sword did not meet the conditions for melting and opening?
The black panther licked it a few times before, but it didn't seem to have any effect.
It wasn't until Li Hao disinfected with boiling water and the panther drank the water that the panther reacted and its fur quickly became smooth.
"If boiling water doesn't work, then boil it over fire."
"Otherwise, there is nothing I can do. Could it be that only dogs can absorb the mysterious substance in it?"
At this moment, Li Hao was at war between heaven and man.
Hesitant, excited, excited, but also worried that the bamboo basket will be empty.
He longs to step into the mysterious realm!
Maybe then, he would have a way to deal with Hongying.
At this moment, he needs to gain such power. Someone is watching him outside, the red shadow will arrive at any time, the night watchman may be looking for someone who can see the red shadow, and there is a spy inside the inspection department...
Thinking about this in his mind, Li Hao's eyes became more persistent.
If it doesn’t work this time, I won’t give up.
The Starry Sky Sword has been soaked in boiling water for a while, and there is no change in the water in the soup bowl.
At his feet, the black panther was a little dazed, lying on the ground, raising his head to look at the soup bowl. He was still eager, but he seemed unable to drink, and he lost some of the urgency he had before.
"Phew!"
Li Hao took a deep breath and walked out of the kitchen with the bowl in hand without rushing to drink.
The security door is locked and the curtains are drawn.
To ensure that no outsiders would see him, and that if someone broke in, he would be able to find out in time, Li Hao returned to the sofa with the bowl and sat down.
In the bowl, the jade sword is still there, and it seems to be more crystal clear now.
Of course, maybe it's just my own illusion.
"The Li family's sword...has been circulated in slang for many years. There is something mysterious about it, right?"
Li Hao picked up the bowl, gritted his teeth, and put the pistol next to him so that he could get it at any time. Then he carefully took a small sip. It was a very small sip. The water was still a bit hot, but Li Hao didn't care about it.
When I took a sip of boiling water, there was no reaction at first, I just felt hot.
But slowly, Li Hao seemed to notice the slightest difference.
A warm current gradually spreads in the belly.
But soon this warm current disappeared.
Li Hao's eyes flashed crazily, is it really useful?
Or is it just an illusion?
He was afraid that it was his own misunderstanding and psychological induction, and that the warm current did not really exist.
"As long as you don't die if you drink it!"
Li Hao was a little bolder this time and took another sip of water. This time he drank a little more, and this time, the feeling was more obvious!
There is really warmth flowing in my belly!
Not only that, at this moment, Li Hao lowered his head and quickly looked at his belly. Near his belly, there seemed to be a faint starlight twinkling.
"Mysterious power?"
Li Hao was shocked. Is this a mysterious power?
After drinking the water, I actually saw a star-like light shining with my naked eyes.
However, Li Hao's expression changed a little at the next moment.
The star-like light suddenly began to extinguish, began to flow, and gradually disappeared, disappearing around Li Hao's body.
The slightly sleepy black panther suddenly opened his eyes, crawled towards Li Hao, stretched out his tongue, and licked the void in the air around him, but unfortunately he didn't seem to lick anything.
"Huh?"
Li Hao frowned slightly and made a quick judgment.
"Starlight is mysteriousStrength? "
"First it appeared in my belly, then it overflowed, and then it disappeared... Is this... I can't retain this power? "
He knew nothing about mysterious power.
However, he has practiced grappling and fighting, and he knows that everything needs some routines and rules to organize and store it.
If you exercise randomly, sometimes you will not only fail to strengthen your body, but will actually wear yourself out. His teacher Yuan Shuo once said this.
And now he is a complete ignorant.
This power may be the mysterious power he desires, but he has no way to preserve it and can only let this power flow out.
"Mysterious power, does it mean that it requires some secret book or something? "
Li Hao glanced at Black Panther at this time. Naturally, Black Panther didn't know how to practice. However, Black Panther didn't practice. He just let the starlight power flow through himself. This energy, even if it only stayed in the body for a while, seemed to have some physical strengthening effects.
At this time, Li Hao looked at the remaining water in the bowl.
Several conclusions were quickly drawn.
First, the jade sword really contains energy like starlight, but it needs to be neutralized by boiling water before that energy can penetrate into the water.
Second, this energy can strengthen the body, but it cannot be retained.
Third, obtaining mysterious power may require cheats or other systems. It does not mean that you will have this power just by absorbing or eating it.
Fourth, maybe I am a waste?
Li Hao thought of the fourth point, and it was not just random thoughts. He was thinking about whether there are any requirements for the cultivation of mysterious power, and does he meet these requirements?
If other people drink this water, will they be able to retain it, but I can't?
This is not impossible!
If everyone could possess mysterious power, it would be impossible for such a huge Silver City to be almost completely unknown. It would only be vaguely aware of the existence of night watchmen, and I'm afraid there wouldn't be too many of them.
After writing down these points, Li Hao felt his body.
It feels like not much has changed.
He didn't become instantly powerful as he imagined, and his hair didn't suddenly turn black and his skin became shiny like the black panther.
"It feels almost like taking a bath in a hot spring. My stomach feels warm, but other feelings... not much! "
Li Hao murmured, and the next moment, he suddenly felt helpless.
Why am I not as good as a dog in my transformation?
After drinking the water, the black panther's hair became visibly brighter, but luckily for him, he didn't feel much.
“Is it possible that I’m not as good as Black Panther? "
Li Hao smiled bitterly.
He was also guessing whether it was the first time he soaked in the water and the effect was better, but it was hard to say. Maybe he was really not as good as the Black Panther?
That's so frustrating!
"This won't work. All the starlight energy seems to be wasted. After it overflows from my body, it disappears very quickly. "
Li Hao frowned and looked at the half of the water left in the bowl, not daring to drink any more at this moment.
Afraid of waste!
This power can still be retained in water and can enter the stomach after drinking it, but once it overflows from the stomach, it disappears directly.
“Can the Starry Sky Sword be soaked in water all the time, or is there a limit to the number of times it can be soaked? "
Too much uncertainty made Li Hao dare not waste this bowl of water easily.
"I currently lack the ability to retain starlight energy. If I can absorb all this energy into my body, there may be some changes..."
"That's not right either! "
At this time, Li Hao suddenly thought of something and murmured: "The main reason is that I am sourceless water. This energy does not absorb much into the body and disappears quickly. Maybe it is because there is no source of mysterious energy in my body..."
It's just a guess. Li Hao really didn't know much about this information.
"We can't just let it go to waste. I don't know how long this bowl of water will last..."
He stood up and thought of somethingWhat?
Maybe, you can try the "Five Animals New Book" that the teacher passed on to you.
This little recipe for correct and reasonable health maintenance was adapted by my teacher based on some ancient civilization records. The teacher is over seventy years old and can still walk like flying and even beat Li Hao violently. This "Five Animals New Book" is still of some use.
"Five Animals New Book" does not involve any specific routines and moves. It is to exercise the muscles and bones of the whole body to the maximum extent and has nothing to do with the mysterious system.
At this moment, Li Hao thought of this because he felt that if he exercised a little, he might be able to absorb more starlight.
As for whether it has any effect, we can only do our best and let fate dictate.
The New Book of Five Animals tells the basic reactions of five kinds of animals in hunting and escaping in daily life. The tiger is powerful, the deer is comfortable, the bear is calm, the ape is nimble, and the bird is light.
Li Hao's teacher Yuan Shuo was particularly good at mastering the methods of apes and birds.
To put it simply, Yuan Shuo hopes that he can escape as dexterously as an ape. Like a bird, he is light and nimble and can cross various obstacles, which is conducive to escaping as soon as possible when encountering danger.
As for Li Hao, when he was at Yincheng Ancient Academy, he studied with his teacher and only learned the Ape Method. The other four were simply exposed to without in-depth study. This thing cannot be mastered overnight and requires continuous study and exercise.
"Try it!"
Li Hao is not an indecisive person, let alone giving it a try and losing nothing.
He warmed up a little and felt that it was easier to adapt than before. He quickly picked up the soup bowl and took a sip of the water soaked in Jade Sword.
The next moment, Li Hao moved quickly like an ape. He raised his heels, stared at his feet, and jumped into the air. His hands were nimble, like ape's hooves. He grabbed the hanging ring hanging in the middle of the living room and started to swing on the ring.
This hanging ring was also installed by Li Hao later. It was specially prepared for studying "The New Book of Five Animals".
Yuan Shu is all about agility.
This is also what Li Hao's teacher is good at, so the first thing Li Hao learned was this, using the existing environment to create better, faster and more labor-saving escape methods as much as possible.
At this moment, Li Hao entered the state and felt that his body was much more flexible than before.
He grabbed the hanging ring, swayed for a while, kicked his feet against the wall, and used the force to fly into the air. He opened his teeth and claws again, like an ape, leaped into the air again, and grabbed the back of the sofa in front of him.
Using his hands, Li Hao continued to run around in the small living room.
It’s a small living room with a lot of stuff but not much space.
But at this moment, Li Hao's figure kept flickering in this small space, extremely agile.
His strength is not too strong, and his physique is not extremely strong. Compared with his friend Zhang Yuan, Li Hao really looks like a young scholar, while Zhang Yuan is more like a bear.
Li Hao's body shape is just right for the ape technique.
If the body is too big, it will be difficult to perform in this small space.
"Phew!"
Rapid breathing sounded in the small living room.
This seemingly simple ape trick is actually very physically demanding. You must cooperate with the breathing techniques noted in the "Five Animals New Book" to use your physical strength properly.
This breathing method is not a profound martial arts secret book. It simply teaches you how to adjust your breathing, when to inhale, when to exhale, how to hold your breath, and how to avoid breathing out...
Of course, it is easier said than done. Yuan Shuo, who adapted "The New Book of Five Animals", was actually easy to adapt, but Yuan Shuo spent a lot of energy in order to adapt the breathing method to match.
Therefore, "Five Animals New Book" is not uncommon in Yincheng Ancient Courtyard. Many people actually know it. Yuan Shuo's hidden skill is the breathing method that seems to be not very important.
As for this breathing method, Yuan Shuo only passed it on to a few of his students.
At this moment, Li Hao's breathing became rapid and he began toKeep adjusting.
The whole set of ape drama actually doesn't last long, only about three minutes from beginning to end. Three minutes is enough to make an adult exhausted under such high-intensity and fast movement.
Li Hao has been practicing for three years, and so far he can barely complete it twice. He will be exhausted in about 6 minutes and unable to get up.
And his teacher, who is over 70 years old, has more physical strength than Li Hao. It is said that the highest record is that he did it five times, which lasted for 15 minutes.
This kind of high-intensity, high-speed, and extremely flexible movements lasted for 15 minutes. Li Hao never believed it.
When encountering danger, if you can run away like an ape for 15 minutes without losing strength, your safety will be greatly increased.
Of course, Li Hao didn't have the time to think too much at this moment.
Under Black Panther's stunned eyes, Li Hao moved quickly.
The tables, chairs, sofas, coffee tables, walls... all at home have become Li Hao's strength. In the whole room, only Li Hao's figure can be seen sweating.
"Twice!"
Returning to the starting point for the second time, Li Hao's breathing was a little unsteady, but he felt that he still had some energy left, and his eyes suddenly shone with joy.
He didn't know what other benefits the mysterious starlight energy had, but at this moment Li Hao felt that it could enhance his physical strength and make his body seem lighter.
Li Hao always felt a little uncomfortable when doing ape plays before. His body was too heavy. Every jump and every effort was very strenuous and tiring.
But today, it seems a little more relaxed.
"Maybe I can do it again!"
Only then did Li Hao have time to look at his belly. The starlight visible to the naked eye seemed to have dissipated a lot, but a faint layer of starlight seemed to emerge on the surface of Li Hao's skin.
Of course, this starlight will dissipate soon, but Li Hao can feel that a lot of these starlights have been absorbed by him.
At this moment, Li Hao's heart moved slightly.
Mysterious power, what exactly is it?
Why is the master of the night watchman so mysterious?
He is not sure whether these people are good at martial arts, or do they have some special abilities like Hong Ying, such as being invisible to others, such as being able to set fire?
If his skills were simply good, then Li Hao felt that he didn't need to know the night watchman. Maybe if he continued to drink water like this and continue to exercise, his skills would get better and better.
"Go on!"
Li Hao couldn't think about it anymore. At this moment, he was in an extremely excited mood.
Although he was very tired and had already practiced twice, he felt that he could continue to persevere. The key was that he had not finished drinking the soaked water.
Li Hao took another sip of the sword-soaking water and jumped up again.
"Here we go upstairs again!"
At the same time, the old neighbor on the second floor cursed. Li Hao also liked to exercise at home in the past, but it didn't last long, usually only a few minutes.
It's a good day today. Did you take medicine?
It's been half an hour, and there's still movement upstairs.
The soundproofing of this old building is not that good. If that boy hadn't been on patrol right now, the aunt on the second floor would have been ready to come and scold him.
"Bang!"
I practiced back and forth for several rounds, rested for a while, drank water, and continued practicing.
This time, Li Hao did not practice like before and stop after practicing twice.
It wasn't until the water in the bowl was finished that Li Hao fell to the ground like a sandbag. For a moment, he felt that he didn't even have the strength to get up.
"Phew!"
Panting for air, Li Hao quickly shut up and began to adjust his breathing according to the breathing method in "Five Animals New Book".
It’s not good to exhale loudly just after a workout.
The "Five Animals New Book" states that you must slowly adjust your breathing at this time, otherwise most of the previous exercise effects will be wasted.
"Huh..."
Li Hao adjusted for a while, his eyes filled with joy.
Of course, it was not nine consecutive times. There was a pause in the middle. The five times my teacher said it were continuous. Li Hao did notBreak the record that your teacher bragged about.
But today, Li Hao had done a triple sequence before and lasted for 9 minutes!
And after that, he still had the energy to continue exercising, which was scary.
"This water... divine water!"
Li Hao took a breath of air when he thought of this. Could it be that the night watchman or the red shadow used this method to strengthen themselves?
It was just the first time I drank it, the first time I came into contact with it, I felt the effect was beyond imagination, and I felt much more energetic than before.
If those people continue to exercise, even if they can't set fire or possess those superpowers, they will be extremely scary, right?
"I...maybe have underestimated the night watchmen. If these people improve like this every day without using their superpowers, can the third generation of Uzumaki really hit them?"
Almost impossible!
The effective range of the third generation of Whirlpool is only 50 meters. The opponent is 50 meters away, and Li Hao has no way of aiming.
Within 50 meters, Li Hao felt that he might not even have time to shoot, and the other party would get close and break his neck!
And if you have some super powers, such as setting fire from a distance or something, it will be impossible to hurt them at all.
"Firearms...may be useless!"
Li Hao was even more worried. Firearms might not have any effect on Hong Ying.
The next moment, he looked at the jade sword at the bottom of the bowl and took it into his hand. His eyes were full of desire and expectation: "Is there a limit to the number of times you can soak in water every day? Can you make such mysterious water every time?"
If it is unlimited and can be brewed at will, it means that Li Hao can drink it every day and drink it at will!
Just be afraid, this thing has limits, and the mysterious starlight power is not unlimited.
Li Hao wanted to study further, but he glanced at the clock on the wall and frowned slightly. Forget it today, it was already 8 o'clock.
He has to go out!
Go to Zhang Yuan's house and have a look.
If he doesn't look at it now, he may not have the opportunity and time to look at it later. He is being targeted now. Taking advantage of the fact that the other person just noticed him today, he has to check in time to see if the stone knife from Zhang Yuan's family is still there.
"The Starry Sky Sword has such ability, then... what about the Zhang family's sword?"
At this moment, Li Hao felt that Hongying's target might be these weapons?
"The Li family's sword, the Zhang family's knife... If the opponent's goals are these, then the Zhang family's sword may not be there anymore, but it's hard to say!"
Li Hao thought, it's really hard to say.
Did Hongying really discover the Zhang family's knife?
It was just a stone. There was nothing unusual about it when it was thrown on the ground. The Zhang family didn't pay much attention to it. After Zhang Yuan's parents died, Zhang Yuan never cared about the stone at all and just threw it somewhere.
Zhang Yuan himself doesn't care. Can the red shadow or the forces behind it be found?
"But if we don't find it... maybe there are still people from the Zhang family who are keeping an eye on us!"
Li Hao's heart was slightly shaken. In this case, it would be safer if he found it. If he couldn't find it, it might be a little dangerous for him to go to Zhang's house.
To go or not to go?
Soon, Li Hao made the decision to go. Of course, safety measures must be taken.
He already had a plan. Even if he went, he had to ensure his own safety.
It would be even better if the Zhang family's knife could be found.
The jade sword may have a limit on how many times it can be used, and it may lose its effect after a few times, but if the Zhang family's sword also has this effect, it means that Li Hao can have more opportunities.
Li Hao quickly stood up and quickly went into the bathroom to rinse off.
After a while, Li Hao walked out of the bathroom.
Get dressed, put on the jade sword, and pick up the pistol.
Just as he was about to go out, he thought for a moment and looked at the black panther lying on the ground and said, "Come on, come with me. You have a good nose, help me keep an eye on him!"
Black Panther also drank water today, which still had some benefits.
This guy is still a dog. If someone is following him and he doesn't notice it, the black panther might be able to notice it.
"Woof!"
The black panther wagged its tail and climbed up, seemingly excited.
Li Hao smiled and touchedHe touched its dog's head and said softly: "Don't bark, biting dogs don't bark! You seem to have become smarter and can understand me. If you find someone following me, don't bark blindly or bite my trouser leg. I will understand! Will you?"
Black Panther actually nodded!
The dog nodded a few times and bit Li Hao's trouser leg. Li Hao immediately laughed.
This is more humane and powerful than the professionally trained dogs in the Inspection Department. Black Panther may be able to bring him some help.
After patting the Black Panther's head, Li Hao thought for a while about how to deal with it and resolve some possible crises.
After confirming the plan, Li Hao took Black Panther out of the house.
Go to Zhang Yuan’s house!
PS: I actually have 100 alliances. I didn’t expect it. Thank you all for your strong support. It’s not in vain that I rewarded myself with a leader, quack, I hope you didn’t see it.
